summary: Batch C C01-C05: vendored gpui-pre 0.3.6 with four visibility-only patches (a11y activation, node_bounds access, text-entry input handler plus node-id-to-FocusHandle resolution, synthetic pointer preservation) and rewired observer.rs, input.rs, and service.rs onto them. cargo check --workspace and the crate gate matrix exit 0, and all 21 gpui-mcp unit tests pass, including the two accessibility observation tests that were previously ignored.

tests.command: cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib (21 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored)
cargo tree -p gpui-pre plus a workspace-wide cargo tree: gpui-pre resolves to vendor/gpui-pre at v0.3.6 and no other crate resolves from vendor/

C01-VENDOR-GPUI-PRE.evidence: Cargo.toml declares [patch.crates-io] gpui-pre = { path = "vendor/gpui-pre" }; cargo tree -p gpui-pre resolves gpui-pre v0.3.6 to vendor/gpui-pre and the workspace-wide tree resolves no other crate from vendor/ (gpui-pre-collections and gpui-pre-util stay on crates.io). The vendored tree is the 0.3.6 archive with exactly one modified file, src/window.rs, per a full-tree diff against the registry copy; Cargo.lock drops only the registry source and checksum for gpui-pre. The pre-patch build behavior is unchanged: cargo check --workspace exits 0 and all 21 gpui-mcp unit tests pass.

C02-A11Y-ACTIVATION-GATE.evidence: vendor/gpui-pre/src/window.rs:1615 initializes a11y_active_flag to !accessibility_force_disabled, so the accessibility tree builds without assistive technology while a platform adapter can still deactivate it. observer::tests::observes_roles_labels_and_parentage asserts debug_a11y_tree_json() is Some on a freshly opened window with no screen reader attached and passes with its previous #[ignore] removed, and the dump carries the application's elements.

C03-NODE-BOUNDS-EXPOSURE.evidence: Window::a11y_node_bounds (vendor/gpui-pre/src/window.rs:6839) returns the node's Bounds<Pixels> from A11y::node_bounds (window/a11y.rs:150) in the same logical pixels the layout engine stored. observer.rs publishes them as protocol Rect through each node's accesskit_id metadata, and the passing tests assert tree.nodes["save"].bounds.is_some() plus the exact Rect mapping in parse_frame.

C04-INPUT-HANDLER-EXPOSURE.evidence: Window::insert_input_text (vendor/gpui-pre/src/window.rs:2327) and Window::replace_input_text (2340) reach the live PlatformInputHandler and its replace_text_in_range; input.rs TypeText and ReplaceText call them and cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests exits 0. Window::a11y_focus_handle (6846) opens A11y::focus_ids (window/a11y.rs:149) and FocusHandle::for_id (window.rs:558), and service.rs Focus resolves the handle before dispatch_focus; the observer test asserts the resolved handle and the resulting focused handle. Text entry has no runtime fixture in this crate, so it is verified at the compile-checked call path.

C05-POINTER-POSITION-PRESERVATION.evidence: bounds_changed (vendor/gpui-pre/src/window.rs:2733) adopts the platform mouse position only when it differs from the last adopted platform position (2741), so a stale platform reading cannot cancel a synthetic hover. input::tests::synthetic_hover_survives_bounds_changed asserts the synthetic position survives a direct bounds_changed, a platform simulate_resize, and a simulate_scale_factor_change (DPI) and passes.

risks: crates/gpui-mcp-html (outside T05 ownership) still carries Batch C referral errors in its runtime test hooks and visual-parity fixture; those expectations were not re-run and may now be stale because C02-C04 landed.

Text insertion and replacement (C04) is verified through the compile-checked call path and code inspection only: no fixture in this crate owns an active input handler that could exercise replace_text_in_range at runtime.
registry.rs:341 still describes the overlay paint pass as the Batch C gap for P-A's overlay row, but no C01-C07 item covers an overlay patch; registry.rs is outside T05 ownership.

The vendored tree is committed whole as cargo vendor produced it (157 files, including .cargo-ok, the crate's own Cargo.lock, and Cargo.toml.orig), a departure from the hand-trimmed vendor/gpui tree Batch A deleted; only src/window.rs differs from the crates.io 0.3.6 archive.
